title: Campaign Soldier
subtitle: In the King's Ranks
bodyText: A campaign soldier drills with spear and shield, keeps equipment ready, and holds position beside the rest of the unit. Dependable service under orders lays the foundation for the judgment and responsibility of command.
sceneBrief: An adult Macedonian campaign soldier practising formation with spear and shield beside fellow soldiers; practical equipment, no messenger dispatch or stores duties.
